Chapter 947: Chapter 11 The Goodwill of the Robber Clan (Please Subscribe)

“Scared?”

Lin Yuan looked at Xia Qin, the peak power, and wasn’t surprised.

Ever since the discovery of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, countless ultimate powers of the twelfth rank wanted to refine the secret realm, but none had succeeded to their satisfaction.

They couldn’t even lock down the exact coordinates of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, let alone refine it?

Now that he had become the master of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, it would indeed shock all the ultimate powers of the twelfth rank.

“When I entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm for exploration, I fortuitously reached its deepest part….”

Lin Yuan casually explained a few sentences.

“I see.” A smile appeared on the face of Xia Qin, the peak power, who didn’t care how Lin Yuan had refined the Xuanhuang Secret Realm. He was only concerned that the realm now belonged to Lin Yuan.

“Good, good, good!”

“Lin Yuan, you probably don’t know what the Xuanhuang Secret Realm actually means for our human civilization!”

Xia Qin, the peak power, took a deep breath and spoke solemnly.

“Its meaning to human civilization?”

Lin Yuan was slightly taken aback.

In his view, the ultimate powers of the twelfth rank wanted to refine the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, guessing that there were important inheritances within, which would be crucial for their own evolutionary paths.

And this was indeed the case.

The three Dao-Protecting Secret Skills of Profound Xuanhuang, let alone for those of the Path Splitting Realm of the twelfth rank, would be of great assistance even to those at the Star Lord Realm or in the Chaos Realm.

But its significance to human civilization?

Due to various reasons, such as to prevent the widespread dissemination of the three great secret techniques of Profound Xuanhuang and the enemy finding a way to break them, Xuanhuang Majesty had left rules prohibiting their transfer to other powerhouses.

Lin Yuan couldn’t think of any grand significance the Xuanhuang Secret Realm could have for human civilization.

The Xuanhuang Beasts within the secret realm? The Xuanhuang Crystals?

Xuanhuang Crystals indeed hold not insignificant value, but for human civilization as a whole, they are merely some kind of scarce resource, not something of great significance.

“For human civilization, the most precious thing is the secret realm itself,” said Xia Qin, the peak power, looking at Lin Yuan.

“The realm itself?”

Lin Yuan pondered thoughtfully.

“Yes, the realm itself.” Xia Qin, the peak power, nodded. “The Xuanhuang Secret Realm can isolate causality and time-space. Even we, the twelfth rank, cannot interfere with everything inside the realm through the barriers of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.”

“Now, the twelve pinnacle clans of the universe on the surface maintain a certain degree of war intensity, but undercurrents are swirling. Those alien races are constantly watching for any genius evolvers emerging from our human civilization.”

“It’s not too bad for those above the sixth rank; even if they fall, they can be revived through their life imprint.”

“But what about those below the sixth rank? Many evolving talents below the sixth rank, showing just a hint of rising potential, are directly cursed and killed by alien races, unable to be revived.”

Xia Qin, the peak power, said.

“Indeed.” Lin Yuan nodded in agreement.

He had also been targeted by an alien curse killing in the past, but his identity was well concealed, and the alien race could only lock onto him over a wide area. Even so, the alien race still forcefully cursed him, but they chose the Tri-Eye Clan genius among those being tested in the Seven Star Cave at the same time.

Lin Yuan was fortunate, and with the Chikun Star Lord having learned from past experiences, his disciple from ten thousand years ago perished this way at the hands of the alien race.

But what about the other human civilization’s evolving talents?

Every year, there’s no telling how many evolving talents below the sixth rank die under curse killings.

In the pinnacle alien races, there are specific powers at the tenth and eleventh ranks who specialize in cursing the human civilization’s geniuses at the fourth and fifth ranks.

To curse kill the fourth and fifth ranks with the life heights of the tenth or eleventh rank doesn’t cost too much for the former, and any price paid can be recovered.

In such a situation, even the most powerful had no solution.

After all, there were only nine supreme powers in human civilization, whose main attentions had to be on the twelfth rank of the alien races.

It was impossible to pay close attention to each and every evolving talent within the civilization.

Moreover, human civilization never stopped attempting to assassinate key talents of other alien races.

“The meaning of the supreme power is?”

Lin Yuan understood what Xia Qin, the peak power, wanted to say.

“Exactly, with the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, we can store a sliver of the soul will of human civilization’s key evolving talents below the sixth rank inside.”

“In this way, even if they encounter curse killings, they can still survive.”

Xia Qin, the peak power, said.

The essence of life lies in the soul will.

The core of the Doppelganger Skill is to transfer a part of the soul will into a new body.

As long as the soul will remains, the flesh and soul can quickly recover.

“Although the pillars of our human civilization are Tenth Rank Evolvers, Eleventh Rank Evolvers, and us of the Twelfth Rank, all have grown from a weaker state. If the evolving talents below the sixth rank survive, our human civilization has a future,” said Xia Qin, the peak power, in an emotional tone.

Just like Lin Yuan, who had grown from the first, second, and third ranks.

“Yes.” Lin Yuan nodded.

For any clan, the foundation is forever the lower layer.

Only when there are more at the bottom can a steady stream of middle, high, and peak levels emerge.

In the ordinary clans amidst the cosmic starry skies, there are many that gather all of their resources to support a single powerful individual, but such clans lose vitality and should anything unexpected happen to that individual, they will face disaster.

“Rest assured, I will set a threshold. To store a sliver of soul will in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, a price must be paid. If some evolving talents can’t pay it for the time being, then they can owe it, paying later when they can afford it,” said Xia Qin, the peak power, with thorough consideration.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm was Lin Yuan’s private property; he certainly couldn’t let others freeload.

“That’s a minor issue.” Lin Yuan shook his head, not at all concerned.

He wasn’t opening up the entire Xuanhuang Secret Realm, just carving out a corner to store some soul wills, which was easy for Lin Yuan.
